verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Medusa CLI documented at docs.medusajs.com/resources/medusa-cli, and the pricing page lists a "Medusa MCP and Cloud CLI", so the product itself ships an official CLI. The evidence is thin on what the CLI does. missing for 10: details of CLI commands and capabilities, evidence of agent- or AI-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
